svg.title: The reaction on a text
svg.desc: The maintainer writes a text to the bot, and the pager sends it to the control repository and reacts with 👀. When GitHub refuses the text, it gets 😢 at once instead, and its thread says why. When the answer or a proposal comes, the 👀 becomes 👍. When the job fails, it becomes 😢, and so does it when no answer came within an hour, which the schedule finds every 15 minutes. An answer that comes after that still turns it into 👍.
